signed_rows.behavior: the scope takes a docs page, an architecture page, a stable decision and a draft decision whose sources the change touched, each with its status and changed files
signed_rows.fails_when: any of the four is missing from the scope, or its status or files are wrong

signed_rows.behavior: the scope leaves out a superseded or deprecated decision, a handoff, the log, index pages and URL sources
signed_rows.fails_when: any of them appears in the scope

signed_rows.behavior: a folder source matches a changed file under it as a prefix
signed_rows.fails_when: a page whose folder source holds a changed file is missing

signed_rows.behavior: a run with nothing in scope writes a report saying no page names a changed file, exits 0, and never calls the model
signed_rows.fails_when: the model is called, the exit is not 0, or no report is written

signed_rows.behavior: run takes only --model, --base-url, --api-key-env, --base (required), --repo, --out, --timeout and --max-requests
signed_rows.fails_when: run accepts another option, such as --audit, --prompt, --skills, --context or --no-shell, or runs without --base

signed_rows.behavior: publish posts only a pull request comment: --pr is required and the issue options are gone
signed_rows.fails_when: publish runs without --pr, or accepts --mention or --repo

signed_rows.behavior: the agent's tools are read_file, search_files and list_files only
signed_rows.fails_when: any other tool, such as run_shell, is given to the agent

signed_rows.behavior: the shipped prompt names kmctl new decision --draft, kmctl verify with --by human:, and kmctl summary ack
signed_rows.fails_when: the prompt lacks any of the three

signed_rows.behavior: the agent script carries no OpenTelemetry dependency or Langfuse code
signed_rows.fails_when: the script header lists an opentelemetry package or the script names LANGFUSE

signed_rows.behavior: audit mode runs on a same-repository pull_request, skips a fork or Dependabot pull request with exit 0, and refuses schedule and workflow_dispatch
signed_rows.fails_when: another outcome for any of those events

signed_rows.behavior: the action's inputs audit, prompt, prompt_file, system_prompt_file, context, skills and mention are gone
signed_rows.fails_when: action.yml still declares any of them

signed_rows.behavior: the agent step passes --base origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF and adds no base-branch worktree
signed_rows.fails_when: the step lacks --base, or runs git worktree add, or passes --instructions-root

signed_rows.behavior: the publish step passes --pr with the pull request's number
signed_rows.fails_when: the publish command lacks --pr

signed_rows.behavior: this repository's knowledge-audit workflow runs on pull_request only, both jobs carry the same-repository condition, only publish has pull-requests: write, and no Langfuse secret is passed
signed_rows.fails_when: another trigger, a job without the condition, write access on the audit job, or a LANGFUSE variable

signed_rows.behavior: no doc, record or shipped file names a removed audit or option outside Corrections, superseded text, release notes, prototypes and the hermes workflows; tests may name them to assert they are gone
signed_rows.fails_when: grep finds a removed name in a live file
signed_rows.command: ! git grep -nE 'docs-vs-code|okf-vs-code|okf-vs-docs|okf-vs-change|prompt_file|system_prompt_file|--skills|--context|run_shell|LANGFUSE|issue_title|instructions-root' -- action action.yml docs packages/kmctl/README.md .github/workflows/knowledge-audit.yml .okf/architecture

signed_rows.behavior: the draft ADR 0060 exists as a draft and ADR 0005, 0017 and 0057 each end with a Correction that links it
signed_rows.fails_when: 0060 is missing or not a draft, or one of the three lacks a Correction linking 0060
signed_rows.command: grep -q '^status: draft' .okf/decisions/0060-*.md && for f in .okf/decisions/0005-*.md .okf/decisions/0017-*.md .okf/decisions/0057-*.md; do awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-27/{c=1} c' "$f" | grep -q '0060-' || exit 1; done

signed_rows.behavior: the repository's hooks pass on every file
signed_rows.fails_when: prek run --all-files exits nonzero

signed_rows.behavior: run refuses a checkout whose git config holds a token header, since read_file can reach .git/config
signed_rows.fails_when: run starts the agent with an http extraheader in git config

signed_rows.behavior: the arguments action.yml's run and publish steps build, captured from a stub uv, parse with the real agent.py parser
signed_rows.fails_when: either step passes a flag or value agent.parser() rejects

signed_rows.behavior: the agent and publish commands this repository's knowledge-audit workflow runs parse with the real agent.py parser, and its audit job checks out with persist-credentials: false
signed_rows.fails_when: a command fails to parse, or the checkout keeps credentials
